readme.summary: The README clearly identifies what basedpyright is (a pyright fork with improvements) but completely lacks any installation instructions, usage examples, or practical documentation beyond linking to external docs.
readme.top_issue: No installation instructions, quick start guide, or usage examples in the README - users must click through to external documentation to learn how to actually use the tool.

security.summary: The code appears to be well-structured and secure, but lacks input validation for Uri parameters and may expose internal details through error messages.
